parentId.description: Id of the comment being replied to.

assetUrl.description: One of the post's `uploadedAssetUrls`, to pin the comment to that photo/video.

attachmentUrl.description: Legacy single-attachment field: a photo/video path returned by `POST /api/uploads`, uploaded by the commenter as part of this comment itself — distinct from `assetUrl`, which instead pins the comment to an existing asset already on the post. Ignored when `attachmentUrls` is sent.

attachmentUrls.description: Photo/video paths returned by `POST /api/uploads`, uploaded by the commenter as part of this comment itself. Takes precedence over `attachmentUrl`.
